docs.screened.component: `Screened` ensures a node preserves its physical size on the glass regardless of camera zoom.
World elements on a desk scale naturally with the camera: zoom in, and a card gets larger.
However, on-screen controls (drag handles, selection badges, resize pins) are sized for a fingertip,
and fingertips do not expand with camera zoom. A control that scaled with the view would become
unhittable when zoomed out and huge when zoomed in.
import { node, Bounded, Screened, rect } from "game-kit";
Holding pixels constant is only right within a reasonable range. If zoomed out excessively,
a fixed-pixel handle would overshadow the entire desk; zoomed in, it would shrink to a speck.
`min` and `max` provide bounds so the node follows the camera outside that range.
docs.screened.screen: A card with a control badge attached. Pan and zoom the view using the mouse wheel or touch gesture:
the card scales with the world, while the screened badge retains its size on the glass.
